core_competencies.name: Customer-backed growth strategy
core_competencies.description: Connects target customer insight, value proposition, channel choice, and business outcome.

core_competencies.name: Measurement and attribution discipline
core_competencies.description: Defines success metrics, attribution assumptions, funnel stages, and experiment design before scaling spend.

core_competencies.name: Campaign ownership
core_competencies.description: Runs cross-functional planning, launch, optimization, and post-launch learning with clear accountability.

core_competencies.name: Amazon-style operational rigor
core_competencies.description: Uses written clarity, mechanisms, inspection cadence, and bias for action while protecting customer trust.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Identifies customer segment, pain point, funnel stage, and expected behavior change.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Describes generic awareness or engagement without a customer or funnel hypothesis.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: Which customer segment and funnel stage would you prioritize first, and why?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Defines KPIs such as conversion rate, CAC, ROAS, retention, pipeline, or revenue with attribution caveats.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Mentions growth or ROI without measurement design.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How would you measure incremental impact versus activity that would have happened anyway?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Explains launch plan, owners, review cadence, dependencies, and optimization loop.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Lists channels or tactics without a mechanism for delivery and learning.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What operating cadence would you use after launch to decide whether to scale, iterate, or stop?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Aligns product, sales, creative, analytics, finance, and leadership around tradeoffs and decisions.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Frames marketing as an isolated execution function.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How would you handle disagreement between brand goals and short-term performance targets?
